h1: Instagram Story Ad Images Built Around a Square Product Photo
lead: Instagram Story ad images from this template are square product photos for a 9:16 Story canvas. Add the image to the layout in your design tool, then place your headline, price, and offer around it.
intro: This template gives you a square product image with a scene that can sit inside an Instagram or Facebook Story design. Place the image in the middle of a tall canvas, keep the upper and lower areas open for your headline and offer, and finish the layout in Canva or Ads Manager.

A square photo can also be used in feed posts, carousels, and listing galleries, or placed in a Story layout. For full-screen movement, use the [Video Ads tool](/ai-video-generation/ugc-ad-video) and choose a 9:16 video frame.
tip: Keep the product clear in the square image, then reserve the top and bottom of the Story canvas for your account name, headline, price, and ad button.

faq.q: Can the story image include my price or discount code?
faq.a: Put them on after downloading, using Canva, CapCut, or Ads Manager. Words generated inside an image can come out misspelled, so it's made without text.

faq.q: Can I mention SPF or skin benefits in the ad?
faq.a: Stick to the wording printed on your product's label, and add it as text yourself. The image shows the product in its setting and shouldn't promise results like protection or clearer skin.

faq.q: Why not crop a square photo to fit Stories?
faq.a: A square image remains easy to inspect when it sits inside a Story layout with space around it. Place it on a tall canvas and add your headline, price, and code around the image. If you need the product to move across the full phone screen, make a separate 9:16 video instead.

faq.q: What dimensions should an Instagram Story image use?
faq.a: This template outputs a square still, not a finished Story-size file. Place it on a 9:16 canvas in your design tool.
